title: Partnership Through-out Morocco
markdown:
**Exciting Partnership Announcement!**

American Group International is proud to announce our new partnership with **American High School in Plantation, Florida**! This collaboration expands educational opportunities for students worldwide, providing access to a high-quality **American high school diploma** through innovative online and in-person learning options.

With this partnership, students can:  
![✅](https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/2705/32.png) Earn a **fully accredited American high school diploma**  
![✅](https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/2705/32.png) Access **flexible online learning** from anywhere in the world  
![✅](https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/2705/32.png) Benefit from **personalized academic support**  
![✅](https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/2705/32.png) Prepare for **university acceptance in the U.S. and beyond**

Cognia Accredited and Online for School, Institutes for direct partnership opportunities.

This partnership strengthens our commitment to delivering top-tier education and opening new pathways for student success.

**Enroll now and take the next step in your academic journey!**
